subject: Seed cohort pricing & proof-of-program clarification
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@brightpathlabs.org>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin Li <kevin.li@brightpath.org>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seed cohort pricing & verification for BrightPath startups

Hi Neha,

We're preparing the cohort packet for our Winter ’27 seed program and would like to confirm eligibility for a program-level rate exception or discount for our 20 portfolio startups. A few details:

- Program is a non-profit accelerator; we run a competitive selection and provide cloud credits and mentorship.
- Typical cohort companies are pre-revenue, < $500K ARR, many are student founders.
- We'd prefer a baseline rate exception applied to hosted API usage (text generation + embeddings) for the cohort for 12 months.

Attached is a short program profile and a CSV export of the current cohort roster (redacted emails). Can you advise what documentation you need to validate eligibility and what a typical seed/cohort discount cadence looks like with Redwood?

Thanks — we want to include your offering in the package materials by next Friday.

Best,
Asha Patel
Program Director, BrightPath Labs

Attachments: SeedCohort_Program_Profile.pdf, BrightPath_Accelerator_Verification.csv

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@brightpathlabs.org>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seed cohort pricing & verification for BrightPath startups

Hi Asha — thanks for the packet, this is exactly the right info to start. A couple quick items to clarify from our side:

1) Typical program proof: a program letter (on letterhead) confirming cohort dates + selection criteria, or a signed CSV with participant names and companies. The attached CSV is helpful.

2) Help us understand expected consumption profile: are you forecasting heavy embedding use (search/semantic similarity) or generation (chat, prompts) for the cohort? A rough monthly token estimate per company helps us recommend either an upfront credit package or a recurring % discount.

3) For accelerator deals we commonly do 1 of the following:
   - 6–12 month timeboxed credit bundle sized to projected usage; OR
   - a cohort discount (commonly 25–40%) on hosted API list rates for 12 months with a soft usage cap before we review.

Ben and Marissa — looping you in for pricing and legal considerations. I copied Kevin so BrightPath can coordinate the verification letter.

I can get an initial cohort offer by EOD Friday if we have the estimated consumption numbers.

— Neha
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick answers below:
- Most teams will use embeddings for discovery and a small number (~4) will prototype chat interfaces (generation).
- Conservative estimate: ~20k embedding units/month and ~80k generation tokens/month per active team during the first 3 months.

I can get a signed program letter this afternoon. Is there a standard verification template you prefer?

— Kevin

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Seed cohort pricing & verification for BrightPath startups

Neha / team — thanks, flagged a couple of internal constraints:

- A program-level discount is fine from a revenue ops perspective but needs a signed MSA or a cohort addendum tied to the cohort roster. We can do a 35% discount for 12 months with a 100k token/month soft cap per company (overage billed at list rates).
- Because this is an accelerator not a registered nonprofit, legal wants either a program letter + attendee roster OR a brief letter from the accelerator confirming the non-profit status of the program itself.
- We should offer an alternative: a credit bundle (equivalent to ~3 months at the discounted rate) prepaid by BrightPath that they can distribute to teams; easier for billing and avoids cohort-wide contract amendments.

Marissa — can you draft the cohort addendum? Jordan — check whether we can waive the requirement for a signed MSA for smaller cohorts (20 companies) and move to an addendum-only flow.

— Ben
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Li <kevin.li@brightpath.org>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Seed cohort pricing & verification for BrightPath startups

Hi Kevin — attaching a one-page cohort addendum template and a short verification template. Quick notes:

- Cohort addendum covers: discount %, enrollment window, duration (12 months), per-company soft cap, and reporting cadence.
- Verification template: one-line letter confirming cohort dates and list of participating companies on letterhead; we accept a signed PDF.

If BrightPath wants the credit bundle route instead, we'll issue a single invoice to BrightPath for the credits and provide redemption codes per startup. That option removes the need for individual company billing and simplifies refunds.

Attaching: SOW_Redwood_BrightPath_v1.2.docx (cohort addendum + verification template included).

— Marissa
Sr. Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_BrightPath_v1.2.docx

From: Asha Patel <asha@brightpathlabs.org>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seed cohort pricing & verification for BrightPath startups

Marissa, Neha, Ben — thank you. We reviewed both options with the leadership team and prefer the credit bundle to start (simpler for cohort logistics). A few answers:

- We'll sign the verification template and send it by end of day Monday.
- We want the credits sized for the projected usage Kevin provided. Please confirm an invoice total and expected redemption window (we anticipate startups will redeem within 3 months of receiving codes).
- Can the credits be converted to a 12-month cohort discount retrospectively if usage spikes? We'd like flexibility to move to a discount if teams exceed the credit bundle.

If possible, we also want a short blurb we can include in our program guide that explains how teams can redeem credits and what support level they get.

Best,
Asha
Program Director | BrightPath Labs
